description: This file contains unit tests for the DefaultClientConfig class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, equality, default values, and configuration value loading from a test configuration file.

classes.name: DefaultClientConfigTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of DefaultClientConfig, including immutability, equality, and configuration loading.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading the 'client-test' configuration before any tests run.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that DefaultClientConfig instances are immutable and that the ClientConfig interface is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultClientConfig's hashCode and equals methods work as intended using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: underTestReturnsDefaultValuesIfBaseConfigWasEmpty
methods.description: Checks that DefaultClientConfig returns default values when initialized with an empty configuration.

methods.name: underTestReturnsValuesOfConfigFile
methods.description: Checks that DefaultClientConfig loads values correctly from a provided configuration file.
